name: Project, Program and Portfolio Landscape
constraints: The landscape is read-only and owns no project, program, portfolio, product, team, cost, benefit or resource fact.
Every node resolves to an authoritative project, program or portfolio identifier.
A tooling board, tracker project or epic tree is not authoritative without an explicit binding.
One project may participate in several roots with an explicit membership role.
At most one financial-consolidating membership applies per project, fiscal period and cost dimension.
Roll-up deduplicates source facts before applying allocation shares.
Allocation shares total at most one per source fact, period and dimension.
Orthogonal product and team decompositions are never summed together.
Contribution claims are non-additive and distinct from exclusive attribution.
Scenario results never feed authoritative actuals or realized benefits.
